query: WITH monthly_visitors AS (SELECT YEAR(entry_timestamp) AS year, MONTH(entry_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS visitor_count FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala WHERE TRIM(visa_type_description) = 'زيارة سياحية' AND entry_timestamp >= '2023-07-01' AND entry_timestamp < '2026-04-11' AND NOT YEAR(entry_timestamp) IN (1902, 1903) GROUP BY YEAR(entry_timestamp), MONTH(entry_timestamp)), growth_calc AS (SELECT year, month, visitor_count, LAG(visitor_count) OVER (ORDER BY year, month) AS prev_month_count FROM monthly_visitors) SELECT year, month, visitor_count, prev_month_count, ROUND(CASE WHEN prev_month_count > 0 THEN ((visitor_count - prev_month_count) * 100.0 / prev_month_count) ELSE NULL END, 2) AS growth_rate_percentage FROM growth_calc ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 1200
raw_question: ما نسبة النمو في عدد الزوار الداخلين بتأشيرة زيارة سياحية لكل شهر في آخر 3 أعوام من اليوم؟
